name: Sri Lanka
overview:
Separated only by a strait, Sri Lanka is a world apart from the subcontinental mainland. Calmness prevails on the island, one that feels hard-earned after decades of civil war.

If the misty tea hills and tropical shores weren’t enchanting enough, the delightful Sri Lankan smiles that greet you across the island will assuredly warm the cockles of your heart.

What struck us most was how little aggression there seemed to be in everyday life. Drivers navigated narrow roads without honking, long taxi rides passed without constant calls or loud music, and even crowded tourist sites rarely felt frantic.

Hence, Teardrop of Joy.
